# Revlet Console (app.revlet.me)

> Business email on your own domain, fast global DNS management, shared team mailboxes, and organization permissions — free to start at $0/mo.

Revlet helps growing businesses, schools, and teams run their cloud infrastructure from one simple, secure console. Create up to 1,000 `@yourcompany.com` mailboxes free, manage domain DNS with one-click restore points, collaborate on shared team inboxes, and set per-organization permissions.

## What You Can Do in Revlet Console
- **Business Email (`$0/mo` Open Access)**: Up to 1,000 mailboxes per organization, 25 email aliases per mailbox, unlimited incoming email, 1,000 outbound emails per month per organization, and 14-day recovery protection.
- **Shared Team Mailboxes**: Set up `hello@`, `support@`, and `billing@` with role-based access (`Full Access`, `Send-As`, `Read-Only`) and no shared passwords.
- **Cloud DNS Management**: Sub-second global updates across 16 DNS record types, unlimited subdomains, zone import/export, and one-click undo snapshots.
- **Team & Multi-Organization Access**: Manage multiple companies or domains from one login with passkey-backed security.
